scope: RoleInstanceSet only; LWS/LeaderWorkerSet is NOT a supported workload type and is out of scope.

premise.claim: On the base branch the discovery ConfigMap instances[].address for LWP/CCP roles does not match any real Pod, and size = role.replicas (not actual pod count).

findings.summary: LWP-on-RoleInstanceSet addresses match real pods for size1 and size2.
CCP addresses match real pods; leader+worker both resolve.
size = actual pod count per role (was role.replicas).
LWP-RIS worker FQDN is canonical but NXDOMAIN under default LeaderOnly (documented PR caveat, not a defect).
findings.liveNote: Resolvability depends on sharedServiceSelection policy; only leader checked for DNS by design.

liveCluster.blocker: PR-head RoleInstanceSet informer cannot decode legacy restartPolicy object-form data on existing RoleInstances; live ConfigMap rewrite blocked, so fix is proven via direct ConfigBuilder run against live cluster state.
